name: Automotive
description: A specialized TEAM and SKILL pack for the automotive career: trade how-to entries (roadside diagnosis, repair, and improvisation across all six Sidewinder tracks) bundled with career-skill entries (diagnostics discipline, mentoring, shop efficiency, customer trust) and team-play entries (crew coordination, bay huddles, triage under pressure, buddy-checks). Built to refine and improve the career, feeding the platform's learning engine toward personal refinement tools.
